trust_decision.summary: TemplateCache decides that a requested template name stays inside the template root by normalizing it (TemplateCache.java:279), but then appends the unvalidated Locale.toString() (language/country/variant) to the already-normalized name before handing it to the TemplateLoader; separately ClassTemplateLoader decides whether a scheme-bearing name may reach URLClassLoader.getResource only when basePackagePath equals "/", which never holds for the ClassLoader-based constructor.

landing_point.why: An advisory titled 'template loading mechanism vulnerable to path traversal' leads straight to TemplateCache.getTemplate's name normalization (and TemplateNameFormat), which is where '..' handling lives; the locale append at TemplateCache.java:924 is 650 lines further down in an inner class.

fix_sites.entry_point: Configuration.getTemplate(name, locale, ...) -> TemplateCache.getTemplate -> TemplateLookupStrategy.DEFAULT_2_3_0 -> lookupWithLocalizedThenAcquisitionStrategy (fix: toLocaleInfix truncating each locale part at '/', '\\', '%', control chars, fix.diff:1644, fix.diff:1692-1734)

public ClassTemplateLoader(ClassLoader, String basePackagePath) with "/" or "" then Configuration.getTemplate(schemeName) (fix: basePackageIsRoot also true for ClassLoader root, multiple leading slashes stripped, fix.diff:202-210, fix.diff:219-220)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: ClassTemplateLoader's guard is a URL-scheme (URLClassLoader) check rather than a '..' check, it only matters for a root base package with the ClassLoader constructor, and the report is about locale/path traversal in the cache, so a solver can call it a separate, configuration-dependent issue.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Localized lookup fallback must keep working: t_en_US.ftl -> t_en.ftl -> t.ftl, including variant and script locales; an over-broad fix (throwing on any odd locale, dropping the locale, or re-normalizing and rejecting) breaks localized template selection and the event sequence existing tests assert. For ClassTemplateLoader, schemeless names under a root base package must still load.

O6_input_shapes: locale country part containing '/' or '\\' (Locale uppercases it)
locale variant part containing '/', '..' steps, '\\' (kept verbatim by Locale)
'%'-encoded separators and control characters in locale parts
ClassTemplateLoader base package "" vs "/" vs multiple leading slashes with the ClassLoader constructor

O7_producer.where: freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/template/utility/StringUtil.java:664-682 (called from freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/core/Configurable.java:2673 for the 'locale' setting / <#setting locale>) splits only on ',_ ' and passes arbitrary tokens to new Locale(lang, country, variant)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ClassTemplateLoader built with a Class and a base package of several leading slashes (e.g. "//"): the post-fix root test stays equals("/") for the Class branch, so the URLClassLoader scheme block is skipped while Class.getResource strips only one slash
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: "//" as a base package is an odd misconfiguration; the fix itself only normalised slashes for the ClassLoader branch (fix.diff:202-209)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the O2 site; different file from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WebappTemplateLoader passes subdirPath+name straight to ServletContext.getRealPath/new File and getResource with no containment check (unlike FileTemplateLoader's canonical-path check), relying entirely on TemplateCache; closed transitively for the locale route once TemplateCache is fixed, so it is defence-in-depth only
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different module (servlet integration); TemplateLoader contract says the cache already removed '..' (freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/TemplateLoader.java:64-69)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different Gradle module (freemarker-javax-servlet), same Java package name freemarker.cache

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second built-in lookup strategy (e.g. trying Locale.toLanguageTag()/BCP47 forms or a customLookupCondition-derived infix) that builds its own localized name instead of reusing lookupWithLocalizedThenAcquisitionStrategy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Lookup strategies are an explicit extension point and maintainers add locale-format variants; a second localized-name builder at distance is exactly the 'second implementation' models miss.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Loader-level localized fallback or a subdir/scheme handling path that bypasses the cache's guarantee
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Webapp loader already has its own path handling (getRealPath vs getResource fallbacks) and no containment check, so a maintainer extending it would plausibly not add one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Servlet-side locale-specific template path (e.g. per-locale subdirectory) built from request.getLocale() before getTemplate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The servlet already deduces locale per request; per-locale directories are a common feature request.

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-23): untrusted locale data concatenated into a template path after name normalization; plus URL-scheme resource lookup through ClassLoader.getResource

O10_build.toolchain: Gradle (Kotlin DSL, wrapper) with JDK 8 + JDK 16 + JDK 17 toolchains; README.md:110 (skipJava9And16SourceSets workaround exists)

j.j_sites_touched: freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/TemplateCache.java, freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/ClassTemplateLoader.java (security-relevant); 18 further source files in the commit are cosmetic refactoring
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Harden TemplateNameFormat / the '..' normalization at TemplateCache.java:279 (or sanitize only the variant, or only '/'), leaving the post-normalization locale append and ClassTemplateLoader's root/scheme guard untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit is a large 'modernize legacy Java usage' refactor (56 sites / 20 files); only the TemplateCache locale infix and ClassTemplateLoader root check are behavioural security changes. Task authoring must strip the cosmetic noise.

FileTemplateLoader's canonical-path check (freemarker-core/src/main/java/freemarker/cache/FileTemplateLoader.java:168-175) already blocks the locale traversal for the default file loader unless disableCanonicalPathCheck=true; hidden tests should use ClassTemplateLoader/URL-based or webapp-style loaders.
